messages.author: Samuel Holmes
messages.body:
Hey there,
I'm trying to understand the syntax for the bridgebyatom keyword with the
hbond command. Could I see it used in an example?
Thanks,
Sam
-- 
Samuel Holmes
Graduate Student of Medicinal Chemistry
VCU School of Pharmacy, Richmond, VA

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
It's just a keyword that tells 'hbond' to print the atom number of the
bridging atom in the bridging residue instead of the residue number of
the bridging residue in the 'Bridge' column of the 'out' file. Try it
on a small (~10 frame) test run.
-Dan
